filler.why: genre verb that says nothing concrete; use the real action
genre adjective; say what is actually better

claims.why: superlative claim — needs proof the owner confirms
guarantee claim — the owner must confirm the terms

buttons.why: start what? name the first step

buttons.why: link label without the article's name (WCAG 2.4.4)
